entries.0ec9d12d73272834: GMO Click Securities, Inc., GMO Gaika Co., Ltd. and others provide financial product trading services such as online securities trading and FX trading. entries.476b0ccdefb50cf7: An internet finance holding company of the GMO Internet Group that provides securities, FX, and crypto asset trading services.

entries.c44767e694473070: The company and 16 consolidated subsidiaries form a group, operating the Securities and FX Business, which provides financial product trading such as securities and FX, and the Crypto-Asset Business, which provides crypto-asset trading. entries.c44c5a99b2601204: As businesses not included in the reportable segments, it conducts the NFT business, virtual office business, medical platform business and others. Operating revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥2,726 million.
